summary: A synthwave-styled variant of the SLOOP groovebox firmware, with a reworked sound bank, drum kits, scenes, effects and a few built-in arcade games.
features: Built on SLOOP and Felucca, with a synthwave look
Sound bank adds Prophet and OberVave-derived presets and 80s-style patches
MORPH wavetable engine in place of the NOISE engine
Many drum kits, including a SYNWAVE kit, and drum processing
Arcade games such as Neon Pang and Neon Bubbles
